text: After consultation with the residents of the Ernest Avenue and Faye Drive area, the overwhelming consensus was that the neighbourhood would like to see a reduction of the posted speed limit to 40 km/h along Ernest Avenue and Faye Drive to enhance safety throughout the area. I respectfully request that this matter be added to the North York Community Council agenda, on Tuesday, January 16th 2018.
North York Community Council: 1. Reduced the speed limit from 50 km/h to 40 km/h on Ernest Avenue and Faye Drive.
